s: American Girl is made up of four divisions: the Consumer Catalogue and E-commerce division; the Publications division; the Retail division; and the American Girl's Brand division. Most American Girl products are marketed exclusively through the American Girls catalogue, web site, and two proprietary retail stores. American Girl-published books are also distributed through several bookstores around the country.
